headline: SDP @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.56 at SEA 4.76, with a projected total of 8.33. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SDP moved -0.59 runs while SEA moved +0.34, changing the projected margin by -0.93 runs. NRFI probability dropped -24.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: George Kirby has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Randy Arozarena, Josh Naylor, Julio Rodríguez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jackson Merrill, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
